visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a male character (Kai) dressed in a black T-shirt, holding a black microphone and standing in front of a NARS retail store entrance inside a shopping mall. He points directly at the camera with a wide smile and high facial arousal. (2) The scene shifts to the store's interior, showing high-end display counters filled with various cosmetic products under bright, white studio lighting. Kai walks through the aisle, gesturing toward the product rows while maintaining eye contact with the lens. (3) Kai holds a black tube of NARS foundation close to the camera lens, rotating it to show the label. His eyes are wide and expressive, and the background displays blurred cosmetic mirrors. (4) A second male character (Jun), identified as a makeup expert, joins Kai; he wears a black jacket and has a calm, friendly expression. They stand together in the store aisle. (5) A macro close-up captures a hand squeezing a beige-toned liquid from a black tube onto a forearm. The skin is well-lit, and the product's creamy texture is clearly visible. (6) Fingers are seen blending the product into the skin on the forearm, demonstrating a smooth, natural finish with visible skin texture transition. (7) Kai holds a small, rectangular liquid blush bottle with a pink cap, presenting it toward the viewer against the backdrop of a store shelf. (8) Jun applies a small amount of pink blush onto Kai's cheek using his fingertip; Kai smiles and turns his face to show the camera the resulting glow. (9) The camera pans across a set of four-color eyeshadow palettes displayed in open black cases on a white counter. (10) Swatches of four eyeshadow shades—beige, light orange, dark brown, and glittery gold—are displayed in vertical lines on a person's forearm. (11) A slim lipstick tube with a rose-pink shade is shown, followed by a swatch of the glossy, pink color being drawn onto skin. (12) Kai concludes the video by holding a black NARS shopping bag, smiling and winking at the camera while standing in the store environment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The track begins with a high-arousal male voice (Kai) speaking Mandarin with rapid enunciation and positive pitch contours. A high-tempo electronic pop BGM with a strong percussive beat and bright synth pads plays continuously at a moderate volume. (2) A subtle mid-frequency 'click' transient occurs as a plastic product cap is opened, followed by a soft friction-based rustling sound as skin is touched. (3) A second male voice (Jun) enters with a lower pitch and more controlled, professional delivery style, maintaining a friendly tone. The BGM continues without interruption. (4) Kai's voice becomes more intense and rhythmic, following the BGM's tempo as he reacts to product details. Faint background room tone from a shopping mall environment is audible but does not mask the speech. (5) Another series of mechanical clicks and soft thuds are heard as products are swapped and placed on counters. The BGM maintains its steady 124 BPM drive. (6) The video concludes with Kai's voice at peak energy and a sharp rising intonation, as the BGM fades out with a clean tail.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Sequence of Product Demonstrations -> Expert Validation -> Call to Action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional showcase for NARS cosmetics, using an energetic host and an expert makeup artist to demonstrate product textures, colors, and effectiveness. It aims to drive sales by highlighting value propositions like 'one-step' application and 'high cost-performance ratio' (CP value).

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct collaboration with a NARS makeup artist, extensive product close-ups, price mentions, and a final shot with a NARS shopping bag.

high_inference.freeDescribe: Professional beauty marketing content with high-quality field audio and rapid visual editing to maintain viewer engagement.
